title: Refine PR168 operation frames: conditional κ = 0.00065591780345
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Refine 64 complex operation frames above PR168 at `4a3c769e5c5430e7114c4d3e099ff34664677f17`, retaining its DAG, coefficients, 2,310 compensated reuse pairs, 47 terminal sinks and physical bit word. Under the retained interfaces:

**κ = 13118356069/20000000000000 = 0.00065591780345.**

This is a small **0.0043305% improvement over pinned PR168** (0.0006558894), and approximately **1.075% above PR176** (0.000648942003256776). The complex supplier binds, at saving `13126968687/20000000000000`. It retains 11,015 physical auxiliary roles, 13,655 persistent roles, rank mass 899,910, deficit 1,320 and largest child 20. No global optimum is claimed.

The finite search alternates single-operation and connected equal-frame component moves between exact lower/upper inclusion bounds. Only the final fixed frames are proof inputs. The complete paid histogram is recounted. Scalar virtual stock, compensated reads, terminal deletions, the full orthogonal-group cardinality, router charge and row reserves remain paid. The arithmetic uses a finer disclosed 10^-14 grid while retaining PR168's strict assembly backoffs.

No hypothesis is strengthened. General Clifford/tensor, uniform weighted compilation, restored-row, paid-layout, precision/recovery and analytic fixed-tape interfaces remain conditional assumptions. Finite checks do not constitute an unconditional multiplication theorem.

Prepared by Rohan Arun with OpenAI Codex assistance. Base construction: eumemic PR168 with its full disclosed lineage. Paired cubes: icekylinx PR144/130; carrier closure: DaysSky PR162; terminal lemma: James Chang PR166; independent packed-column and terminal audits: Chafik Boukhalfa PR176; open frame descent: Joel Pulikkan PR167. Original notices and all prerequisite files remain unchanged. See the package NOTICE for full attribution.

## Validation

- Fresh source producer and unchanged PR168 `make paired-cube-verify`: PASS.
- Candidate physical and terminal checks: PASS, including source/value containment, all role and target chronology, complete forward/reflected histogram, dirty-register restoration, three physical and four terminal corruption controls.
- Unchanged independent PR176 terminal checker reproduces the entire positive-rank histogram. Its unchanged exact packed-column executor checks all **13,655 formal columns in both directions**, restores all **11,015 dirty registers**, and rejects three additional corruption controls.
- Exact inherited paid assembly passes all **47 strict inequalities and seven margins**. The adjacent complex grid point fails the retained rational upper-bound test; this is only a fixed-enclosure exclusion.
- Read-only packaged verifier pins the complete prerequisite source tree and all new inputs. It regenerates the graph/word, checks the unchanged bit supplier, recomputes both ledgers and executes the independent audits.
- **Full repository verification PASS** on `2c4a380126640abfcdce398ced255d1dd5d1d007`: `make -j1 verify` and the own packaged verifier completed in 3340.2324075698853 seconds; 79 isolated modules, 20 patch checks, no source drift. **All 48 research-head CI checks PASS.** The following receipt/docs-only update does not claim a new executable research run.

Run:

```sh
python3 -B research/paired-cube-frame-refinement/verify.py
```

This is a historical improvement over the named pinned comparisons, not a current record claim.
